title: Personalized Differentially Private Online Minimum Bipartite Matching in Spatial Crowdsourcing
motivation: Untrusted servers in spatial crowdsourcing leak location privacy; users need personalized privacy levels
problem_framing: Online bipartite matching with ε-geo-indistinguishability where workers/tasks choose own (h,ε) preferences
key_insight: Quadtree structure enables intuitive coarse-grained level selection, combined with truncated geometric mechanism to satisfy ε-geo-indistinguishability at each level
method_signature: GMT mechanism on quadtree + EMD distance + accelerated distance calculation for matching
evaluation_criteria: Total travel distance of matching under differential privacy constraint
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: HST-based approach requires prior user distribution knowledge which may differ from true distribution
thinking_moves: 把隐私偏好的直觉选择映射到四叉树层级结构上
将连续二维位置问题转换为一维节点编号便于几何机制处理
识别距离计算的时间瓶颈后提出加速方法
